builds.name: 兽王猎（团本+练级伤害天花板）
神戒双修（pve联盟）
builds.description: 思路是神圣系放弃救赎之魂（只要活着就没用）和愈合祷言，换苦修(30级优先出)和新生希望（减灵魂虚弱时间），提高铺盾速度和修血能力；戒律系放奔神御盾（初期不赌暴击）和灌注，用爆发型技能换常驻治疗效果。如果团队需要灌注或者很缺蓝，可以从神圣系挪7点到戒律系（33/18），把精神敏锐 冥想 心灵之力 神御盾 灌注都点满。
builds.descriptionEn: The idea: in Holy, drop Spirit of Redemption (useless as long as you are alive) and Prayer of Mending, taking Penance (grab it first at level 30) and Renewed Hope (shorter Weakened Soul) to shield faster and patch health better; in Discipline, skip Divine Aegis (no crit gambling early) and Power Infusion, trading burst cooldowns for constant healing throughput. If the raid wants Power Infusion or you are badly mana-starved, move 7 points from Holy to Discipline (33/18) and max out Mental Agility, Meditation, Mental Strength, Divine Aegis and Power Infusion.

builds.description: 这两天研究了很多 我认为奶德在pvp上的加强超过了pve 几个关键的点：1.小迅捷不吞回春 2.大地母亲减回春野性成长小迅捷公cd，从此加血就只用按123，更不用说还有大迅捷，3.在点出野性成长的同时还可以点出平衡系虫群，同时和自然壮丽联动，3dot（月火虫群+强化天赋的纠缠根须），双hot+大小迅捷，完全可以实现0读条，全瞬发，无脑不用看哪里亮，只要舍得嗑药和道具拉满，除了会净化的职业稍微注意点之外基本野外没有天敌，可以拉扯耗死很多人，唯一缺陷可能就是没有wlk和时光服里鸟德秒人的手感[doge]，不过鸟德也容易被秒，这一套手不贱基本死不了
builds.nameEn: Strongest Solo World PvP Resto/Balance — No Arguments
builds.descriptionEn: Been researching this for the past couple of days, and I think the Resto Druid buffs do more for PvP than for PvE. Key points: 1) Swiftmend no longer eats Rejuvenation. 2) Earth Mother cuts the GCD of Rejuvenation, Wild Growth and Swiftmend, so healing is just pressing 1-2-3, not to mention Nature's Swiftness. 3) You can grab Wild Growth while still affording Insect Swarm from Balance, which synergizes with Natural Splendor: 3 DoTs (Moonfire, Insect Swarm, empowered Entangling Roots), double HoTs plus big and small Swiftmend — completely instant casts, zero cast time, no need to watch for procs. As long as you are willing to chug potions and burn consumables, you have basically no natural predators in the open world besides classes that can dispel — you can kite and wear most people down until they die. The only flaw is probably missing the Boomkin one-shot feel from WotLK and Timewalking servers [doge], though Boomkins get one-shot just as easily. Play with a bit of restraint and you basically won't die.

builds.description: 副本里带出来的防装也很能打，不用再配装，切一套天赋就行了，能稳吃物理系，防骑五五开，打不过术士，牧师。打法师要看对面技师，自由药不能省，有一战之力，如果后面能给补个盾反就吊啦

Beats physical DPS reliably, goes even with Protection Paladins, loses to Warlocks and Priests. Against Mages it depends on the player; never skip the Free Action Potion and you have a fighting chance. Add a Spell Reflection and it'd be nuts

builds.name: 暗牧pve
builds.description: 自用天赋，会随着手感和装备调整。
builds.descriptionEn: Personal build; it will be adjusted as I get a feel for it and as my gear changes.

builds.name: 纯娱乐向奶萨拉面天赋
builds.description: 纯拉面天赋，非常娱乐仅供参考玩耍不要当真。此天赋必须解决的一个核心问题是：需要双持但是无限服看不出来萨满能否双持，如果不能就直接gg。这么点主要是激流着实有点拉胯说实话。
builds.descriptionEn: A pure "noodle" (Chain Heal) build, very casual, for reference and fun only, don't take it seriously. One core issue this build has to solve: it requires dual-wielding, but on the Infinite server it's unclear whether Shaman can dual-wield at all; if not, it's dead on arrival. The points are spent this way mainly because Riptide is honestly pretty weak.

builds.name: 增强

builds.descriptionEn: The Resto Druid tree has points to spare, not many talents there are worth taking.

builds.name: 恶魔术（练级专用）
builds.description: 一怀我大号ss练级选的吸吸流，这次实在不想再玩这种流派了，刚好恶魔感觉加强了不少，换个思路玩玩不要太当真
builds.descriptionEn: On the first Classic run my main warlock used the drain-tank leveling style; this time I really didn't want to play that again. Demonology feels buffed quite a bit, so I'm trying a different approach, don't take it too seriously.

builds.name: 暴力牺牲毁
builds.description: 点不出灭杀有点蛋疼，但是毁灭系的感觉没什么可以移除了，都很香。。。
builds.descriptionEn: Not being able to pick up Decimation is a bit painful, but there's nothing in the Destruction tree I feel I can drop, it's all too good...

builds.name: 狂暴战pvp
builds.description: 娱乐天赋仅供讨论本人不一定实操。缺点很明显没有致死不能当搅屎棍，但是优点也有，选侏儒配合天赋可以两次解减速，拦截cd也更短，看以后套装效果和其他补丁再决定要不要起这个号。
builds.descriptionEn: A for-fun build, for discussion only; I may not actually play it. The downside is obvious: no Mortal Strike, so it can't be a disruption tool. But it has upsides, as a Gnome, together with talents you get two ways to break slows, and Intercept has a shorter cooldown. I'll decide whether to level this character after seeing future set bonuses and other patches.

builds.name: 经典武器战pvp
builds.description: 最新beta天赋更新后强化猛击要点满了，从双手武器那里挪出一点来看起来可行。
builds.descriptionEn: After the latest beta talent update, Improved Slam needs to be maxed; moving one point out of the two-handed weapon talent looks workable.

builds.name: 戒律牧-竞技场
builds.description: 快速治疗速抬血，只是觉得戒律大招有pvp点废柴
builds.descriptionEn: Flash Heal for quick topping up; I just feel the Discipline capstone is a waste of points in PvP.

目前标准牺牲火毁

builds.descriptionEn: Fire Destruction is basically uncontested, this is the one build.

builds.name: 防战纯pve天赋
builds.description: 打本纯T天赋
builds.descriptionEn: Pure tank build for running dungeons.

builds.description: 15%的概率获得寒冰指相当于常驻15%暴击，比火焰31点的燃烧可能更实用。
builds.descriptionEn: A 15% chance to gain Fingers of Frost works out to a permanent 15% crit, which is probably more practical than the 31-point Fire talent Combustion.

builds.name: 奥法瞬发大火球

builds.descriptionEn: Arcane Blast stacks the damage, Arcane Missiles as a fallback, and Presence of Mind + Pyroblast added to the rotation.

builds.name: 牺牲火毁
builds.description: 影与焰提供不错的火毁输出循环，后期这套伤害应该很可观。
builds.descriptionEn: Shadow and Flame gives Fire Destruction a solid damage rotation; later on this build's damage should be considerable.

builds.name: 近战流
builds.description: 咋样？
builds.descriptionEn: How's this?

builds.name: 野兽
builds.description: 60野外练级之王，无人能敌
builds.descriptionEn: King of level 60 open-world leveling, second to none.

builds.name: PVP暗影戒律MS
builds.description: 戒律出苦修，暗影出沉默，神圣出防打断和减少受到的法术伤害。因为神圣多的这几点无论是加到戒律还是暗影收益都没神圣这里收益高。如果蓝耗够，也可以把戒律的强化心灵之火点出来，这样就增加了物理减伤。
builds.descriptionEn: Discipline for Penance, Shadow for Silence, and Holy for pushback protection and reduced spell damage taken. Those extra points in Holy are worth more than putting them into Discipline or Shadow. If mana allows, you can also pick up Improved Inner Fire in Discipline for extra physical damage reduction.

builds.name: 狂暴初期 pve
builds.description: 目前尴尬的局面只能放弃爆伤
builds.descriptionEn: With the current awkward situation, I can only give up on the crit damage.

builds.name: 双减速，双胖子，cc流，双斩杀，残血逃不掉！
builds.description: 疲劳诅咒（怕驱散），献祭（燃烧）前期爆发，中期两胖子承伤，腐蚀术，痛苦灾祸，吸血（有胖子打不断吸血），尾段献祭燃烧，暗影灼烧带走。
builds.nameEn: Double Slow, Double Voidwalker, CC Build, Double Execute - No Escaping at Low HP!
builds.descriptionEn: Curse of Exhaustion (vulnerable to dispels), Immolate + Conflagrate for the early burst, two Voidwalkers soaking damage in the mid-game, Corruption, Curse of Agony, Drain Life (with a Voidwalker out the drain can't be interrupted), then Immolate + Conflagrate again at the end, finished off with Shadowburn.

builds.name: 射击猎
builds.description: 命中达标后
builds.descriptionEn: After hit cap is reached.

builds.name: 防骑 pve 通用天赋
增强

builds.descriptionEn: Dungeon

builds.name: 增强
builds.description: 练级

builds.descriptionEn: Leveling

builds.name: PVEMS
builds.description: 适合多样化治疗手法的MS
builds.descriptionEn: A priest suited to a variety of healing styles.

builds.name: 神戒战场和FB兼顾天赋
builds.description: 因为没有走暗戒掉天赋，所以抵抗沉默点满了。基本上副本的治疗能力也有，回蓝和节蓝天赋都出了，FB治疗能力也足够。野外就暗戒，FB和战场就神戒
builds.nameEn: Holy/Disc Build for Battlegrounds and Dungeons
builds.descriptionEn: Since I didn't go the Shadow/Disc route, silence resistance is maxed out. It still has solid dungeon healing, both mana regen and mana-saving talents are taken, so dungeon healing is sufficient. Shadow/Disc for the open world, Holy/Disc for dungeons and battlegrounds.

builds.name: 无限无敌防骑
builds.description: 随便A，无所畏惧，不缺蓝，还回血
builds.descriptionEn: AoE freely, fear nothing, never short on mana, and it even heals you back.

builds.name: 保证生存 保证伤害
能打 能跑
builds.description: 可以把命中和移动速度点到自然主义
builds.descriptionEn: You can put the hit and movement speed points into Naturalist.

builds.name: 标准牺牲火毁
builds.description: 吃魅魔，起手暗灼，献祭，烧尽，循环简单粗暴
builds.descriptionEn: Sacrifice the succubus, open with Shadowburn, then Immolate and Incinerate, a simple, brutal rotation.

builds.name: 完美防战天赋
builds.description:
强化英勇没点是因为本来就泄怒才会用到技能
强化战术掌握是为了拦截后还能接个技能
强化战术掌握是因为这个技能战斗中也能增加愤怒
强化雷霆不点是因为本来雷霆用的就不多 boss 不断就好 小怪群拉都是吼挫志
builds.descriptionEn:
I skipped Improved Heroic Strike because it only gets used when I'm already dumping rage.
I took Improved Tactical Mastery so I can still follow up with another ability after Intercept.
Improved Tactical Mastery also helps because it generates rage in combat too.
I skipped Improved Thunder Clap because I barely use Thunder Clap anyway — it just needs to keep the debuff on the boss; for trash packs I use Demoralizing Shout.

builds.name: fz练级天赋
builds.description: 从防战天赋开始加
builds.descriptionEn: Start by putting points into the Protection tree.

builds.name: 简单易懂的牺牲火毁
builds.description:
保持腐蚀术和献祭，打暗影灼烧保持“影与焰”buff（毁灭系倒数第二层），持续打烧尽，走位时用燃烧填充伤害。
腐蚀术只加1点，是为了把读条降低到1.6秒，因为公共CD是1.5秒，点满的意义不大。
builds.descriptionEn:
Keep Corruption and Immolate up, use Shadowburn to maintain the "Shadow and Flame" buff (second-to-last tier of Destruction), spam Incinerate, and fill with Conflagrate while moving.
Corruption gets only 1 point to bring the cast time down to 1.6 sec, since the global cooldown is 1.5 sec — maxing it isn't worth it.

builds.name: 毁伤pve
builds.description: 目前来看我依旧将毁伤毒药看做是敏捷没有上去之前盗贼的前期天赋，密谋和冷血的选择其实无伤大雅，但是强化刺骨我个人还是不太习惯点出（如果我玩贼的话无限服我肯定不打算玩pvp了，双天赋剩下的选择我会另点一套适合小怪场景的天赋，这里不再赘述）。
builds.descriptionEn: For now I still treat Mutilate poison as an early Rogue build before Agility gets high. The choice between Murder and Cold Blood honestly doesn't matter much, but I'm personally not used to picking up Improved Eviscerate. (If I played a rogue on the Infinite server I definitely wouldn't do PvP; for the second dual-spec I'd build a separate set suited to trash clearing — no need to go into that here.)

builds.name: 战匕pve
builds.description: 结合最新设计师放出的消息（DZ是单体纯木桩最高输出），加上毒药看起来并没有被加强到一个碾压众生的水平，结合一怀时期盗贼的输出模式来看，可能战匕还会是大后期装备起来之后输出的不二选择？（或许敏捷要到500以上吧）。这套天赋中战斗系有不少天赋是属于过路生存向的，可以按照个人需求和习惯修改，这里不做强制推荐。
builds.descriptionEn: With the latest word from the designers (rogues are the top single-target pure-patchwerk DPS), plus poisons not looking buffed to a game-breaking level, and judging by how rogues dealt damage back in Classic, Combat Daggers may still be the go-to late-game DPS once gear ramps up (maybe Agility needs to pass 500). A lot of the Combat talents here are filler/survival picks, so tweak them to your own needs and habits — no hard recommendation from me.

builds.name: RP防战主T！
builds.description: 感谢借鉴～
builds.descriptionEn: Thanks for the inspiration!

builds.name: 狂暴战团本pve纯输出
builds.nameEn: Fury Warrior Raid PvE Pure DPS

builds.description: 防护圣骑士的仇恨主要依靠神圣伤害，提高圣印审判伤害，减少审判cd，配合清算仇恨稳定
builds.descriptionEn: Prot Paladin threat comes mainly from Holy damage: boost Seal and Judgment damage, lower Judgment's cooldown, and pair it with Reckoning for steady threat.

builds.name: 仇恨FQ
builds.description: 仇恨最大化
builds.descriptionEn: Maximum threat.

builds.name: 无敌的惩戒骑
builds.description: 感觉把输出向的都点到位了
builds.descriptionEn: Feels like every DPS talent is covered.

builds.name: 联盟天裔法师
builds.description: 联盟天裔法师，因为有种族天赋2分钟一次，喝水的时候开，几秒能回满所以不缺蓝，其他种族不推荐
builds.descriptionEn: Alliance Skyborn mage: the racial has a 2-minute cooldown, pop it while drinking and you're full again in a few seconds, so mana is never an issue. Not recommended for other races.

builds.name: 兽王
builds.description: 无敌兽王天赋
builds.descriptionEn: Invincible Beast Mastery build.

builds.name: 双手法伤骑士
builds.description: 穿智力法伤装拿双手武器，天赋出强化奉献，当圣洁光环用，放弃了力量和强度加成天赋，战斗中换武器可以直接当奶，因为神圣打击吃武器伤害，所以用双手武器不用单手加法伤盾。
builds.descriptionEn: Wear Intellect/spell power gear and wield a two-handed weapon; the build takes Improved Consecration and uses it like Sanctity Aura. I gave up the Strength and attack power talents. You can swap weapons mid-fight and heal directly — since Holy Strike scales with weapon damage, use a two-hander instead of a one-hander plus a spell power shield.

builds.description: 玩呢
builds.descriptionEn: Just messing around.

builds.name: 野德pve变换之力低蓝耗版
builds.description: 很适配新版思路，但是命中要和恢复的50%战斗中回蓝做取舍
builds.nameEn: Feral Druid PvE — Shapeshift Power, Low Mana Version
builds.descriptionEn: Fits the new design direction well, but you have to trade hit rating against the 50% in-combat mana regen from Restoration.

builds.name: 武器战PVP，下马打击，刺耳。

builds.name: 野外最舒服的伪平衡

builds.descriptionEn: It's all about attrition: kite and trade hits, cast when the haste proc is up, offense and defense in one.

builds.name: 戒律牧万金油
builds.description: 除了灵感，啥都有。
builds.descriptionEn: Everything except Inspiration.

builds.name: 练级生存
builds.description: 自己试试看好用不好用[翻白眼]
builds.descriptionEn: Try it yourself and see if it works [eye roll].

builds.name: 刺耳防战
builds.description: 舍弃三点强化破甲出刺耳，看满级后实战是否起手缺怒
builds.descriptionEn: Drop three points of Improved Sunder Armor to pick up Piercing Howl — we'll see at max level whether the opener is actually rage-starved.

builds.name: 战士T天赋
builds.description:
盾墙15分钟cd无伤大雅，一场战斗能用一次就行，其他T也就一个减伤。

防御等级也无法堆到免爆，点一点过渡下。

核心我认为还是要有暴力，更多的暴击才有怒气，以及挂流血，更高的仇恨。
builds.descriptionEn:
Shield Wall's 15-minute cooldown is no big deal — once per fight is enough, and other tanks only get one damage reduction cooldown anyway.

You can't stack enough defense skill to become crit-immune, so one point is just a stepping stone.

I think the core is still raw aggression: more crits means more rage, plus bleeds and higher threat.
